messages:
julia: Heads-up — I opened a set of cross-repo PRs that need a coordinated merge order: SDK client bump -> API header compatibility -> console runtime image -> helm chart values. Links: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/412, https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/809, https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/233, https://github.com/redwood/charts/pull/77

liam: Thanks. Which one blocks which? can we list exact signal for 'ready to merge'?

julia: SDK (412) is small; it depends on API adding the optional X-Client-Checksum header (809). Console (233) expects the runtime image with the new entrypoint, and charts (77) flips the image.tag and enables the checksum feature flag. So ordering: API 809 -> SDK 412 -> console 233 -> charts 77. Ready = API tests green + 2 approvals, SDK green + 1 approval, console green + runtime image built, charts green + CI lint pass.

anya: runtime note: the new entrypoint needs a tiny init.sh change, I pushed a runtime image build to staging: docker.pkg/redwood/runtime:rtd-2026-03-15. Console PR needs to reference that tag or we get 404s on startup.

tom: @julia I can review API 809 today. I'll flag any breaking header semantics. If it's truly additive (optional header) I can approve after unit tests.

liam: If tom approves API 809 by 11am PT, Julia — can you merge SDK 412 right after? We should avoid concurrent chart updates that might flip traffic.

julia: Yes — plan is: Tom reviews/approves 809 -> I merge 809 -> CI triggers and API deploy to staging; once smoke tests pass I'll merge SDK 412. Then I ask @anya to push a new runtime image tag if needed, and then merge console 233, and finally charts 77.

anya: I'll watch the staging deploy and push a patched image if the entrypoint tweak is needed. Helm values snippet console needs to use: 
```yaml
image:
  repository: docker.pkg/redwood/runtime
  tag: "rtd-2026-03-15"
features:
  clientChecksum: true
```
You can override during upgrade with `helm upgrade --set image.tag=rtd-2026-03-15 redwood-console ./charts/console`

release-bot: Merge window reminder — high-risk cross-repo merges are preferred in the 14:00-16:00 PT window to ensure on-call coverage. See https://go/release-windows

julia: Good call. Tom, can you aim to finish review by 10:30 so we can fit the 14:00 window? If anything blocks, comment and we'll move to tomorrow morning.

tom: Will do, aiming for 10:15. If tests fail I'll request changes; otherwise I'll add an approval.

liam: One more practical: please do not squash SDK 412 commits — it keeps the bisect info for header spec.

julia: noted. I'll also add a short PR checklist comment on each PR with the merge order and required post-merge steps (invalidate cache, bump chart values).

anya: I'll be on-call 13:30-16:30 PT and can roll back the runtime image if anything odd shows up.

liam: :thumbsup:

julia: Thanks all — I'll post updates in this thread as we move through the window.
